definitions.explanation: A hand-held fan made of paper or silk stretched over ribs that can be folded when not in use. A traditional Japanese item used for cooling and in traditional arts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{扇子|せんす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: I can't do without my folding fan in summer.

examples.japanese: {扇子|せんす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦{涼|すず}んだ→涼む：03927_suzumu⟧。
examples.english: I spread open the fan and cooled off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}→日本舞踊：28381_nihonbuyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{扇子|せんす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{小道具|こどうぐ}→小道具：12521_kodougu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: I bought a beautiful folding fan as a souvenir.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE: {扇子|せんす} is a symbol of Japanese culture and has been used for centuries. It's not just for cooling - folding fans are used in:
- ⟦{日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}→日本舞踊：28381_nihonbuyou⟧ (Japanese dance)
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony)
- ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧・⟦{狂言|きょうげん}→狂言：04456_kyougen⟧ (Noh and Kyogen theater)
- ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ (comic storytelling)

VERBS USED WITH {扇子|せんす}:
- {扇子|せんす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to open a fan)
- {扇子|せんす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧ (to close a fan)
- {扇子|せんす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{扇|あお}ぐ→扇ぐ：00004_aogu⟧ (to fan with a fan)

CONTRAST: ⟦{団扇|うちわ}→団扇：04544_uchiwa⟧ is a non-folding, rigid fan - more casual and often given away free as advertising.
